newsitem.title: USA: Roy Weston CEO, 2 other executives resign.
newsitem.headline: Roy Weston CEO, 2 other executives resign.

text.p: Roy F. Weston Inc said Thursday that its president and chief executive officer, William J. Marrazzo, has resigned effective May 23.
The company said Marazzo resigned "to provide the newly-elected Weston board of directors with maximum flexibility in its stated intention of redefining the company's strategy."
An interim replacement is expected to be named by the board of directors at its annual shareholders meeting, May 23, the company said.
The company also said that Peter Marks, chief operating officer, and M. Christine Murphy, chief financial officer, have also resigned. Both it said, left for the same reason as Marrazzo.
William Mecaughey, currently corporate controller, has been named to replace Murphy. No replacement for Marks was announced.
Weston is an environmental services firm engaged in consulting, engineering and design, environmental construction and facilities business systems outsourcing for public and private sector clients.
The company reported a loss of $16.7 million, or $1.74 per share, on revenues of $263.3 million in 1996, with most of the loss attributable to restructuring charges.
